name: Let It Die - Complete Save Editor & Encyclopedia
changelog: New PySide6 interface with the existing save engine preserved.
Fixed fighter and catalog selection, premium decal editing, and inventory reads.
Separated exact material quantities from additive actions; corrected slot references when removing stock.
Removed duplicate writes and surfaced autosave errors; restored account re-binding through the original API.
Expanded integration tests and rewrote the developer documentation.
